objects_built.name: record_audit_event

templates_considered: audit_changes: fit, used its structure (audit table, one writer function, edits call it, audit log not editable)

ai_cost_and_agent_safety, rate_limiting, approved vendors, retained data, and others: did not fit the ask

Edits to audited tables are recorded
Patches to audited tables are recorded
Deletes from audited tables are recorded
Audit entries cannot be edited or deleted

assumptions: $auth is available inside record_audit_event when called from an authenticated endpoint
refunds, customers, tenants and users are the sensitive tables for SOC 2 change evidence
audit_log.actor_id links to users, following the pattern in the workspace
Advisory enforcement is the right default for a new control
confusions: Catalogue says object.statement_required inspects query, tool, task, message; functions are not listed, so the db.del in delete_user_account is not checked by AUDIT-002. The skill does not say whether the list is exhaustive for this check
AUDIT-001 rule 2 and AUDIT-002 rule 4 both use table.write_location_restricted with overlapping writes; the template suggests both, unclear whether one is enough
Whether $auth is populated inside a function called by an endpoint was assumed, not confirmed
The enum for audit_log.action vs the free text action input: the catalogue does not say what happens on a value outside the enum
wished_for: A checked example where an audit function is called from a function (not an endpoint) and the rule passes
A way to say that a table is audited in one place rather than listing it in every rule
Confirmation of which object kinds object.statement_required inspects, including functions
why_confidence: The policies parse and the dry run shows no blocked objects, and the audit trail mechanism is enforced on four tables. Confidence is medium, not high, because access reviews and change approvals are outside what policies can see, the audit covers only four tables, and writes inside functions other than delete_user_account are not checked. The me PATCH role write (a finding) is left unfixed.
